about.title: Welcome to PouaHom Deutschland e. V.
about.text: PouaHom Deutschland e. V. brings our community together through culture, heritage, solidarity and shared projects.

aboutPage.tagline: Preserving our culture. Bringing generations together. Passing on our heritage.
aboutPage.introP1: PouaHom Deutschland e. V. is a non-profit association founded in 2021 and based in Karlsruhe, Germany.
aboutPage.introP2: Our association was born from a shared intention: to preserve, promote and pass on Baham culture while creating a space for connection, exchange and solidarity for everyone who feels linked to it.
aboutPage.identityP1: PouaHom Deutschland e. V. brings together women and men who share a connection with Baham culture or simply wish to discover it, support it and help its influence grow.
aboutPage.identityP2: We believe a culture remains alive when it is known, practiced, shared and transmitted to future generations.
aboutPage.identityP3: Through our association, we aim to build a bridge between our cultural heritage and our life in Germany, while helping younger generations better understand their roots.
aboutPage.missionP1: The core mission of PouaHom Deutschland e. V. is to promote Baham culture.
aboutPage.missionP2: To make this mission concrete, we organize and support cultural gatherings and events that showcase our heritage, strengthen ties between members, and foster the transmission of our values and traditions. Our commitment is selfless and focused on the public good: the association's resources are used exclusively to achieve its objectives.
aboutPage.openP1: Above all, PouaHom Deutschland e. V. is a space for meeting, dialogue and transmission.
aboutPage.openP2: The association is politically and religiously neutral. It welcomes anyone connected to Baham culture, or anyone interested in it, who wishes to contribute to the association's momentum.
aboutPage.openP3: We want everyone, regardless of generation or experience, to find their place and take part in the life of the association.
aboutPage.factInclusive: Open to anyone connected to or interested in Baham culture

unitySharing.text: Creating moments of connection and strengthening ties between members of our community.

openness.title: Openness
openness.text: Introducing Baham culture beyond our community and encouraging exchange in our wider environment in Germany.

engagement.title: Commitment
engagement.text: Encouraging everyone to actively contribute to the life and projects of the association.

aboutPage.futureP1: Preserving our heritage does not only mean looking to the past.
aboutPage.futureP2: With PouaHom Deutschland e. V., we want Baham culture to live today and tomorrow by creating opportunities to meet, share knowledge and pass on to the next generations what forms an essential part of our heritage.
aboutPage.finalLine: Together, let us keep Baham culture alive in Germany and pass it on to future generations.

board.title: Our Board
board.description: Meet the women and men who make up the Board of PouaHom Deutschland e. V.

members.member1: Leads the board, coordinates strategic direction and represents the association externally.
members.member2: Supports the president in key initiatives and helps drive operational delivery across teams.
members.member3: Manages meeting records, internal coordination and board documentation processes.
members.member4: Oversees budgeting, financial planning and transparent reporting for association activities.
members.member5: Represents the women of the association, advocates for their interests and supports their participation in association life.
members.member6: Reviews the accounts and verifies the proper financial management of the association's resources.
members.member7: Ensures compliance with the association's statutes and decisions, and brings matters requiring attention to the board.
